name: bbc-meta-settlement
title: Meta to pay up to $18bn to settle claims its platforms harm children

knownGaps.why: Limitation of the supply bound, and the narrowest kind. A settlement story quotes figures either side of 21 million ZEC, so one abbreviates to "#.#M ZEC" while its neighbour still renders every digit. Any threshold has a boundary and some page will straddle it; the alternative is abbreviating amounts a person could actually transact, which is a worse trade. Only the pages that quote both a market-scale figure and a near-supply one are affected.
